STANDALONE CONNECTION LAB

Connect with a short code.

Create a private ten-character code, share it with your partner, then approve their request.

Experimental connection testWormhole handles pairing and holds the code reservation. Iroh carries messages through its relay. Both services see connection IPs and timing; your partner is not given your IP by this transport. A code proves possession, not a person's identity.

Start a session

Idle

Keep the full code private. A new session uses a fresh code. Closing a paired session ends the connection for both participants.

Someone wants to join

Confirm that your intended partner is requesting now. Rejecting ends this pairing; create a fresh code to try again.

Messages

    Messages stay in memory. If cleanup fails, keep this page open and use Retry cleanup when the connection returns, within five minutes. The page can also retry when the browser reports it is online. These share one retry; neither rejoins the room. If both browsers crash or cleanup cannot finish, the server may retain the reservation until expiry.
